opening.argument: The video centers on a free framework for detecting warning signs before viewers commit capital, rather than directing them to make an investment. It explains how retail participants can absorb insider selling, how coordinated posting can manufacture the appearance of organic interest, and how influencers may receive discounted tokens with vesting schedules that let them sell before retail participants. It also identifies declining spot volume and thin bid-side order-book depth as signals to inspect. The stated purpose is preventative: viewers are given tools to evaluate risks before buying. A separate exchange deposit-bonus offer is mentioned, but the supplied material does not connect that promotion to the warning analysis or establish its terms or outcomes. The accompanying disclosure also states that cryptocurrency trading carries considerable risk and guarantees no particular outcome.
